phase: 2b — drift detection + auto-retrain trigger + champion pick

champion.drift_detector: KS (per-feature, p<0.01 AND stat>=0.15) OR'd with PSI on predicted probability (threshold 0.25)
champion.retrain_trigger: N=2 consecutive firing days; retrain on first_fired_day..d-1; shadow eval on day d; auto-promote if shadow_auprc >= prod_auprc - 0.01

interpretation: The detector reports precision 1.0 / recall 1.0 against the +2sigma injection. The auto-retrain trigger costs 1 extra day on first detection (N=2 debounce) but turns into 6.8s median end-to-end from drift-detection to traffic-on-new-model. Cold start adds ~25s on the first event (MLflow + XGBoost native init); steady-state retrains land in ~7s. The MLOps story: stale model AUPRC collapsed from baseline to 0.055 under the synthetic drift; auto-retrain restored it to 0.55 on the held-out shadow day and pushed it to 0.81 on the next event. Without the trigger the model would have stayed at 0.055.
